linkedin.text:
A cliffside gala works because of one thing: the drop. People stop talking when the table is at the edge and the sea is a long way down.

This is our own coastline footage from southern Italy. Terraced towns, a working harbour, and a group that spent the evening facing the water rather than a stage.

The production problem with cliff venues is access. The road is narrow, coaches usually cannot make the final approach, and every crate of glassware finishes the journey by hand or by small van. Budget the labour honestly and it is a superb evening. Underestimate it and your team is still setting up when guests arrive.

We would rather tell you the awkward part first.

Planning a coastal gala for 2026? Send us the headcount and we will tell you which venues can actually take it.
